articles.title: A Rare Celestial Show: Total Solar Eclipse to Sweep Across Europe and Parts of the U.S.
articles.summary: On Wednesday, a total solar eclipse will darken skies over Iceland, Greenland, Spain, and Russia. It's Spain's first mainland total eclipse since 1905. A partial eclipse will be visible from Alaska to North Carolina.

articles.title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey Ink Landmark Defense Pact, Insist It's Not Against Iran
articles.summary: The Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, signed Friday, binds Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey to mutual defense. Officials stress it's purely defensive and open to other nations, amid U.S.-Iran tensions.

articles.title: Incredible 2,000-Year-Old Roman Shipwreck Found Off Sicily, Loaded with Amphorae
articles.summary: A fisherman's scanner led to the discovery of a 69-foot Roman shipwreck 150 feet deep off Sicily. The vessel, dating to the 2nd or 1st century BC, holds hundreds of intact amphorae once filled with wine and oil.
